    "When bad debts occur, the first entry writes off debtors by debiting Bad Debts A/c and crediting Debtors A/c.",

      "status": "explicit",
      "alters_key_if_changed": true,
      "convention_evidence_ids": []
    },
    {
      "condition": "When an adequate provision for doubtful debts exists, bad debts are adjusted against that provision",

    }
  ],

    {
      "option": "A",
      "status": "supported",
      "false_part": "",
      "premise_source": "excerpt",
      "evidence_id": "E1.1",
      "premise_quote": "When such a provision already exists, the loss due to bad debts during the current year are adjusted against the same",
      "reason": "Correctly records bad debts write-off and adjusts them against the existing provision."
    },
    {
      "option": "B",
      "status": "contradicted",
      "false_part": "Revaluation A/c Dr ₹15,000; To Provision for Doubtful Debts A/c ₹15,000",
      "premise_source": "excerpt",
      "evidence_id": "E1.1",
      "premise_quote": "When such a provision already exists, the loss due to bad debts during the current year are adjusted against the same",
      "reason": "Bad debts are adjusted against provision, not charged additionally via Revaluation."
    },
    {
      "option": "C",
      "status": "contradicted",
      "false_part": "Revaluation A/c Dr ₹15,000; To Debtors A/c ₹15,000",
      "premise_source": "excerpt",
      "evidence_id": "E1.1",
      "premise_quote": "When such a provision already exists, the loss due to bad debts during the current year are adjusted against the same",
      "reason": "Existing provision must absorb bad debts before any charge to Revaluation."
    },
    {
      "option": "D",
      "status": "contradicted",
      "false_part": "Bad Debts A/c Dr ₹15,000; To Revaluation A/c ₹15,000",
      "premise_source": "excerpt",
      "evidence_id": "E2.1",
      "premise_quote": "To Sundry debtors 1,000 (Futher bad debts)",
      "reason": "Bad debts credit Debtors, not Revaluation."
